description: This file provides database connection management, including connection pooling, transaction handling, and basic SQL operations such as select and truncate, specifically tailored for a MySQL database with Cloud SQL proxy configuration.

methods.name: newDBConnectionPool
methods.description: Creates and returns a new pooled database connection using MySQL configuration.

methods.name: maxParallelism
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of parallel database connections based on runtime CPU count.

methods.name: GetDBConnectionPool
methods.description: Provides a singleton database connection pool, initializing it if not already created.

methods.name: SingleTransactionInsert
methods.description: Performs batch insert operations within a single transaction, rolling back on errors.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Executes a query and processes each row with a provided handler function.

methods.name: TruncateTable
methods.description: Executes a TRUNCATE statement on the specified table.
